signature: isolateFloor(floorName: string, options?: { flyTo?: boolean }): void
code: const FLOOR = 'A_6F'; ssp.objectsTool.setVisibleByFloor(FLOOR); const target = ssp.objectsTool.getByUserDataProperty('floorName', FLOOR)[0]; if (target) { await ssp.cameraController.flyToObject(target); console.log('isolated to', FLOOR); } else console.log('floor not found:', FLOOR);
guard: setVisibleByFloor 只显目标楼层, 其它楼层被隐藏 (单边开关)
要恢复其它楼层，调用 ssp.objectsTool.resetVisibility()
GLB 必须有 userData.floorName, 否则该层不会被识别
